methodology.name: bidirectional position-number and regime walk-forward lab
methodology.positions: ascending rank in sorted winning set, not physical draw order
methodology.positionPrior: Exact order-statistic probability for uniformly random 10-of-20 combinations; shrinkage PRIOR=80
methodology.regimeRule: PRE-TARGET drift in mean sorted rank: mean absolute difference between last 30 draws and preceding 170 draws >=0.8 means POSITION_DRIFT_HIGH; otherwise POSITION_DRIFT_LOW.
limitations: Regimes are exploratory and must be detectable before target draw; labels are not evidence of causal predictability.
Many comparisons imply multiple-testing risk; intervals are unadjusted descriptive intervals.
Number-to-position maximum-likelihood ranking is a challenger, not a promoted strategy.
No production weights or engine settings are changed.
